# AI Sales Advisory

> AI Sales Advisory is a UK consultancy that helps owner-led small and medium-sized businesses use AI to win more sales. We find where a business is losing sales, then design, build and look after custom AI to win them back: mainly voice agents (AI that answers and makes calls), plus lead follow-up and admin automation. The people who advise are the people who build.

## Who it's for

Owner-led small and medium-sized businesses in any sector, especially where enquiries arrive by phone and a missed call, a slow reply or an unchased quote means a lost sale. Typical problems: calls after hours, at weekends or while the owner is on a job or on holiday; questions nobody can answer in time; quotes nobody follows up; admin that eats into selling time. We work with businesses across the United Kingdom, online.

## What we do: Advise · Build · Support

- Advise: a free 30-minute AI growth call gives an honest view of where the business is losing sales and a suggested first step, even if that step isn't AI. An AI growth plan is a separate, deeper piece of work, scoped and priced up front.
- Build: custom voice agents designed around each business (its customers, rules, systems and brand). They answer calls, take enquiries, book appointments, follow up quotes and hand over to a person when they should. Every build starts with a focused pilot on one type of call, measured against what happens today.
- Support: once an agent is live, we review its calls and handovers, keep it up to date as prices, services and hours change, fix issues and report on what it does for sales.

How we work: Free AI growth call → Plan & design → Build & pilot → Support & improve.

We also design and build voice agents for agencies and software firms to offer under their own brand.

## Common questions

- Do I keep my phone number? Yes, in most cases. Calls can be forwarded to the agent when you don't pick up, outside opening hours, or all the time.
- Will customers know it's AI? We recommend being upfront, and design how the agent says so. Customers can always reach a person.
- What if the agent can't help? We agree in advance what it handles. When unsure it asks for detail, transfers the call, arranges a callback or logs the request.
- Do I need to be technical? No. We set up the connections (phone line, calendar, booking or job system, CRM such as HubSpot) and show you how to check calls.
- What does it cost? Scope, price and timing depend on the business and are agreed before any work starts. The first call is free.
